target_customer: Sales teams, VC firms and quant funds that buy structured company signals data
problem: Public information about companies (hiring, news, product launches, funding) is scattered across websites, and sales and investment teams spend long hours on market research to find companies ready to buy or raise.
business_model: Usage-based data subscription sold by API, flat files and webhooks

founders.name: Roq Xever
founders.background_notes: YC page bio mentions working with Ruby on Rails. TechCrunch says he took a loan from his mother when the company nearly ran out of money in 2017.

founders.name: Matic Perovsek
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page and called CTO by TechCrunch. Education and employers not found.

founders.name: Miha Stanovnik
founders.background_notes: Named as a founder by TechCrunch in August 2019, not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: CaaS Technologies
competitors.what: Spinout from Social Capital that was reported to offer data driven insights to VC firms

technical_complexity.rationale: Crawling sites, press and job pages and extracting events with supervised machine learning across about 20 million companies by 2019 was hard for a tiny team but used standard techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Scraped public data was reproducible by others; value came from the accumulated structured history and extraction quality.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many data providers later appeared as alternatives per comparison pages in 2026; none acquired PredictLeads and it remains private with 11 to 50 employees per LinkedIn.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2019 reports eight VC customers, a profitable business and demand from investors wanting to spot growing companies early.

identity.voice_and_tone: Functional, data focused, now AI agent positioned

branding.community_and_virality: None found; coverage is TechCrunch 2019 and comparison pages.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name tied to lead prediction, no brand assets or community found; the company sells on data, not brand.

outcome_analysis: PredictLeads was profitable at the time of YC in 2019, serving eight VC customers, and has stayed independent and active in Ljubljana. It has moved its pitch from VCs and sales teams to data for AI agents. Public sources show no large venture rounds, so growth looks capital efficient but the scale is modest with 37 people per the YC page.
notes: TechCrunch says founded 2016 while YC lists 2018. TechCrunch (2019-08) says the company was raising a 1.5M seed at a 10M valuation, not confirmed as closed. Aggregators disagree (CB Insights 170K, PitchBook 869K, Seedtable 150K pre-seed); all unverified and not recorded as rounds. Competition search found only 2026 vendor pages, none dated near 2019.
